# xAI / Grok Build policy reference

Checked 2026-10-11. Read the repository README's **Data policy** section before uploading confidential documents. Follow [chat response rules](chat-start.md); an actual reply is enough and is not verified reading or legal consent.

The [official security FAQ](https://docs.x.ai/developers/faq/security) has a Grok Build CLI section describing privacy controls and the distinction between ZDR and other configurations. [Enterprise documentation](https://docs.x.ai/build/enterprise) distinguishes local tool execution/history from remote inference and organization-level controls. Consult the actual CLI account and settings; do not apply Grok web/mobile rules or assume ZDR, training opt-out, a fixed retention period or offline processing. Do not change those settings automatically. Other models/providers require their own applicable policy; the xAI recommendation remains pending evaluation.
